cards.target: Acho que ele está certo.
cards.english: I think he's right.

cards.target: Ele disse que estava cansado.
cards.english: He said he was tired.

cards.target: Não acho que ele esteja certo.
cards.english: I don't think he's right.

cards.target: É provável que eles cheguem amanhã.
cards.english: It's likely they'll arrive tomorrow.

cards.target: Vou ficar te devendo essa, tá?
cards.english: I'll owe you one, okay?

cards.target: Não tenho certeza de que ele venha.
cards.english: I'm not sure he's coming.

cards.target: Tá ligado no que eu tô falando?
cards.english: You know what I'm saying?

cards.target: Quando eu puder, te ligo.
cards.english: When I can, I'll call you.

cards.target: Ela perguntou aonde eu estava indo.
cards.english: She asked where I was going.

cards.target: Quanto mais cedo ele chegar, melhor.
cards.english: The sooner he arrives, the better.

cards.target: Sempre que eu puder, vou te ajudar.
cards.english: Whenever I can, I'll help you.

cards.target: Ele me pediu que esperasse do lado de fora.
cards.english: He asked me to wait outside.

cards.target: Parece que vai chover.
cards.english: It looks like it's going to rain.

cards.target: Ele admitiu que tinha errado.
cards.english: He admitted that he had been wrong.

cards.target: Ela perguntou como eu tinha descoberto.
cards.english: She asked how I had found out.

cards.target: O fato é que precisamos agir.
cards.english: The fact is we need to act.

cards.target: Mesmo que eu quisesse, não conseguiria.
cards.english: Even if I wanted to, I couldn't.

cards.target: Ela disse que tinha terminado o trabalho.
cards.english: She said she had finished the work.

cards.target: O político prometeu que reduziria os impostos.
cards.english: The politician promised he would reduce taxes.

cards.target: Sempre que eu posso, ajudo meus vizinhos.
cards.english: Whenever I can, I help my neighbors.

cards.target: Sem que percebessem, ele já tinha saído.
cards.english: Without them realizing, he had already left.

cards.target: Nego que ele tenha me dito isso.
cards.english: I deny that he told me that.

cards.target: Ele me perguntou por que eu estava triste.
cards.english: He asked me why I was sad.

cards.target: Quem quer que seja, diga que não estou.
cards.english: Whoever it is, say I'm not in.

cards.target: Não acredito que ela consiga sozinha.
cards.english: I don't believe she can do it alone.

cards.target: Ela prometeu que voltaria antes das dez.
cards.english: She promised she would be back before ten.

cards.target: Ele afirmou que estaria lá às oito.
cards.english: He stated he would be there at eight.

cards.target: Pode ser que ela mude de ideia.
cards.english: It could be that she changes her mind.

cards.target: Por pouco que seja, qualquer doação ajuda.
cards.english: No matter how little, any donation helps.

cards.target: É fato que a economia está crescendo.
cards.english: It's a fact that the economy is growing.

cards.target: Ele falou que não podia ir à festa.
cards.english: He said he couldn't go to the party.

cards.target: Ele disse que não concordava com a decisão.
cards.english: He said he didn't agree with the decision.

cards.target: O atendente disse que lá não aceitavam devolução.
cards.english: The clerk said they didn't accept returns there.

cards.target: Ela me avisou que a estrada estava perigosa.
cards.english: She warned me that the road was dangerous.

cards.target: Ele disse que nós nos veríamos em breve.
cards.english: He said we would see each other soon.

cards.target: Não é verdade que ele trabalhe tanto assim.
cards.english: It's not true that he works that much.

cards.target: Não é certo que ele venha à reunião.
cards.english: It's not certain he'll come to the meeting.

cards.target: Ele me pediu que mantivesse sigilo sobre o assunto.
cards.english: He asked me to keep the matter confidential.

cards.target: Queira ou não queira, ele vai ter que aceitar.
cards.english: Like it or not, he'll have to accept.

cards.target: O funcionário explicou que o sistema estava fora do ar.
cards.english: The employee explained that the system was down.

cards.target: Não parece que vá chover hoje.
cards.english: It doesn't seem like it's going to rain today.

cards.target: Ela perguntou quando a reunião ia começar.
cards.english: She asked when the meeting was going to start.

cards.target: Ele disse que adoraria ir, mas não podia.
cards.english: He said he would love to go, but couldn't.

cards.target: Ela garantiu que entregaria o projeto no prazo.
cards.english: She guaranteed she would deliver the project on time.

cards.target: Ele perguntou se eu podia emprestar meu carro.
cards.english: He asked if I could lend him my car.

cards.target: É hora de que todos assumam suas responsabilidades.
cards.english: It's time for everyone to take on their responsibilities.

cards.target: O presidente declarou que tomaria todas as medidas necessárias.
cards.english: The president declared he would take all necessary measures.

cards.target: Por menor que seja o esforço, já é alguma coisa.
cards.english: However small the effort may be, it's already something.

cards.target: Basta que ele peça, e eu ajudo.
cards.english: All he has to do is ask, and I'll help.

cards.target: Por pior que seja, temos que encarar.
cards.english: However bad it may be, we have to face it.

cards.target: Ele respondeu que não tinha tempo naquele momento.
cards.english: He replied that he didn't have time at that moment.

cards.target: O advogado informou que o processo demoraria anos.
cards.english: The lawyer informed us that the lawsuit would take years.

cards.target: Ele afirmou que nunca tinha visto nada parecido.
cards.english: He stated that he had never seen anything like it.

cards.target: O técnico garantiu que o problema seria resolvido naquele dia.
cards.english: The technician guaranteed the problem would be solved that day.

cards.target: Em tempo, registro que as alterações foram homologadas.
cards.english: By the way, I should note that the changes were approved.

cards.target: Ela perguntou se eu ia à festa no sábado.
cards.english: She asked if I was going to the party on Saturday.

cards.target: Ele explicou que a situação era mais complicada do que parecia.
cards.english: He explained that the situation was more complicated than it seemed.

cards.target: Ela contou que aquele tinha sido o melhor dia da vida dela.
cards.english: She said that had been the best day of her life.

cards.target: Ela disse que pensaria na proposta e daria uma resposta.
cards.english: She said she would think about the proposal and give an answer.

cards.target: Mal se deu conta do problema, já era tarde demais.
cards.english: No sooner did he realize the problem, it was already too late.

existing_tips: 'Dado que' + indicative when stating a fact.
Subjunctive used in the third person to express 'let him/her'.
